nodes.name: NOTES.txt
nodes.summary: Empty Helm NOTES template placeholder for the sample webhook chart; it renders no post-install usage notes.

nodes.name: apiservice.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm-templated APIService registration exposing the sample webhook as v1alpha1 in its API group, with cert-manager CA injection from the webhook serving certificate.
nodes.languageNotes: Relies on the cert-manager.io/inject-ca-from annotation to have cert-manager populate caBundle from the serving Certificate secret.

nodes.name: deployment.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm-templated Deployment for the sample aggregated API server webhook, serving TLS on port 8443 with the cert-manager-issued serving certificate, health probes, and values-driven scheduling settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Serving certificate and key are mounted from a Secret at /tls and passed to the server via --tls-cert-file/--tls-private-key-file flags.

nodes.name: pki.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm-templated PKI chain for the sample webhook: a self-signed Issuer, a root CA Certificate, a CA Issuer backed by that root, and a serving Certificate with in-cluster DNS names.
nodes.languageNotes: Demonstrates cert-manager's self-signed bootstrap pattern with a 5-year root CA and a 1-year serving certificate.

nodes.name: rbac.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm-templated RBAC bundle for the sample webhook: its ServiceAccount, request-header authentication Role and RoleBinding in kube-system, auth-delegator ClusterRoleBinding, plus a domain-solver ClusterRole and binding for cert-manager.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines a local webhook-authentication-reader Role as a workaround for Kubernetes versions before 1.17.

nodes.name: service.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm-templated Service exposing the sample webhook's HTTPS port and selecting its pods, used by the APIService registration.
